decisions.reason: A low-cost accessory with its own page costs almost nothing to keep listed, so the option stays open while demand is still unclear.
This box trailer series sits in the firm's core range and is featured on the home page, and after one year its value is still uncertain, so keeping it open is cheap relative to the potential upside.

The car transporter is a niche product shown only on its own page, so it is slightly more at risk, but one year is too short to resolve its value and keeping it in a modular production setup costs little.
This low-bed series is a core volume range promoted on the home page, and nothing so far signals failure, so keeping it is justified.
This high-cover series is a variant built on existing platforms and promoted on the home page, which makes it cheap to maintain while its demand becomes clearer.
This second box trailer series overlaps with B, which makes it the likelier candidate for consolidation, but without negative evidence yet the option is worth keeping.
